description: Waste received at the landfill of Greater Amman is a data set listed in opendata.gov.jo, an open data portal, published or maintained by Greater Amman Municipality. The amount of waste received in the landfill. Coverage: Jordan. The portal files it under the publisher Greater Amman Municipality. Its tags are The amount of waste received in the landfill. It offers 2 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Jordonian License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste-facility and collection planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-jo-portal.
